Question Choices: Select. Which values satisfy BOTH? x < 80 and x ≥ 72: ~~85 | 80 | 75~~
Hints: Keep values in the overlap, and check both endpoints.
Solution: Both conditions require 72≤x<80. 85 is above the upper bound; 80 equals the excluded upper bound; 72≤75<80 is true. Only 75 satisfies both.
